facts.title: Korean glyph coverage with the default font chain

detail.styleWithoutBigFont: Standard (3=txt.shx, 4=empty) — MTEXT Hangul renders as `?` under the shipped default chain
detail.workerCaveat: FontManager.setFontMapping() exists only on the main thread; the mtext worker pool has no mapping channel in 1.6.3, so SHX substitution for MTEXT needs useMainThreadDraw:true or an upstream change
detail.note: the mlightcad font repository ships Korean SHX big fonts (whgtxt/whgdtxt/whtgtxt/whtmtxt, encoding euc-kr) but no Hangul mesh/TTF font
no public length getter on AcDbCurve; length summed from subGetIntersectCurves() primitives (AcGeLine3d.length / AcGeCircArc3d.length / AcGeSpline3d.length)
no single "render complete" event; use AcTrView2d.waitUntilIdle(timeoutMs) or isProcessingEntities

AcTrView2d.addTransientEntity() is async fire-and-forget (asyncDraw().then(...)) and returns void; AcTrView2d.setTransientEntityVisible() also returns void — only AcTrScene.setTransientEntityVisible() returns boolean. AcTrView2d.hasEntity() never sees transients.

detail.appEditApi: acapRunDatabaseEdit(db, label, fn) — wraps AcDbDatabase.runDatabaseEdit and emits `undo-stack-changed`

detail.signature: dxfOut(_fileName?, precision?, version?, optionsOrThumbnail?: boolean | { saveThumbnailImage?, format?: 'ascii'|'binary' }) : string | Uint8Array
detail.viewerCommand: CDXF (AcApConvertToDxfCmd) exports the current document through the same path

facts.title: paper space layouts and viewport drill-down

detail.switchApi: AcTrView2d.activeLayoutBtrId = <block table record id>  +  AcApDocManager.setActiveLayout(view, db)
detail.drillDown: AcTrView2d.pick() drills through AcDbViewport rectangles in paper space (pickThroughViewports); near the border the viewport entity itself is picked

detail.autoResolution: none — the viewer never fetches xref targets by itself
detail.evidence: AcTrView2d.missedData.xrefs collects { name, pathName, isOverlay } for unresolved external references
detail.manualApi: AcApXrefManager.instance.attachOverlay({ blockName, fileName, content|sourceDb, sourcePath, transform?, insertId? }) → AcApXrefSession
detail.sessionShape: AcApXrefSession { id, blockName, insertId?, overlayId, sourcePath, visible }
detail.overlayApi: AcApDocManager.loadOverlay(fileName, content, options) / registerOverlayDatabase(db) / setOverlayVisible / removeOverlay / clearOverlays / getOverlayIds
detail.overlayLimitation: AcApDocManager.loadOverlay doc comment: INSERT expansion, viewports and dimensions are skipped in overlay geometry

detail.api: AcApDocManager: documents / documentCount / document(i) / activeSessionId / activateDocument(doc) / closeDocument(doc) / sessionFor(doc)
detail.splitView: ensureSplitView(container) creates a second AcTrView2d; openDocument(..., view) targets it
detail.caveat: one shared AcTrView2d per canvas; switching parks/restores the scene via captureSessionState/restoreSessionState
